# lamp BOM and launch commitment

Case: CASE-001
Document control number: SPEC-0001
Effective revision: C
Superseded revision visible in archive: R9
Subject: one pallet of Luma lamps
Primary measure: revision-C bulbs required for 120 four-lamp kits
Source finished or header quantity: 120
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 4 EA
Unit: EA
Eligibility definition: nettable LMP-BULB-12 units
Exclusion definition: quarantined and reserved bulb units
Control: material readiness versus the protected assembly calendar

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000001, organization SEA, and CASE-001. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from qualified non-displacing WC-2 slots; external timing is conditional on Rainier's confirmed standard and expedite dates. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
